_comment: Martyr Lifegain (2026-11-10), Kami of False Hope + Abiding Grace: with Grace out the self-only gate OFFERS the Kami sacrifice to the search (its MV-1 return pays), but sacrificing it pre-combat prevents this turn's combat damage. Serra Ascendant + Kami (both 1/1, not sick) are exactly lethal at 2: the search must attack, not sacrifice -- the projection (PendingAttackDamage) reads 0 after a sacrifice, so it cannot mistake a prevented combat for lethal.
